void fourier::fft1 ( double  data[],
unsigned long  nn,
int  isign 
)

Fast Fourier transform for 1-dimensional signals.

Data are transformed in-place and are 1-offset. The nn parameter MUST be the double of the FFT window (2 * WINDOW). The isign parameter sets the direction of the operation.
